title: Move finding_verifier hook from post-advance (assessment_loop) to pre-persistence (workers/orchestration/findings.py) — closes #335 visibility window
goal: #335 wired the verifier as a post-advance hook in `assessment_loop.py`. That means findings are FIRST persisted with their original (un-verified) severity, then the verifier runs in the next advance and downgrades. There is a brief window — possibly several seconds, longer if the next picker call stalls — where downstream consumers (UI Mission Control polling, report exporters, webhooks) see a critical severity that the verifier would have downgraded. The fix is to call the verifier from the orchestration finding-persistence path BEFORE the finding row is written, so the severity that lands in the DB is already verifier-adjusted.
scope: Add a verifier call inside `workers/orchestration/findings.py` (or whichever module is the canonical persistence point — confirm via Grep at task start) at the point where a finding row is about to be committed. For critical/high findings, call `finding_verifier.verify_finding(finding, run, scope)` synchronously, apply the verdict to the in-memory Finding object before flush, then persist. Remove or downgrade the assessment_loop.py hook (keep it as a backstop for findings that bypass the orchestration path, if any). Tests: prove that on persistence of a critical finding the DB row already carries the verifier verdict + adjusted severity (no second-pass downgrade visible).
generation_reason: Identified during the 10-task deferred-capability audit. #335 chose the assessment_loop hook because workers/orchestration/ was must_not_touch in #335's package — but the contract for #335 was 'enforce that critical/high findings are verifier-checked before persistence', and post-hoc downgrade leaks the un-verified state. Operator pushback 2026-05-17: 'Findings worden eerst gepersisteerd met ORIGINAL severity, dan downgradet de verifier mogelijk. Klein venster waar consumers un-verified critical zien.' This task explicitly permits touching workers/orchestration/findings.py because closing the visibility window is the actual contract.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Hook relocation + small orchestration change only. Do NOT modify the verifier strategies (#335 contract), do NOT add new severities, do NOT change FindingAiEnrichment.metadata_json layout, do NOT extend the verifier to medium/low/info severity.
constraints.structural_independence: Verifier still imports zero runner modules (per #335). Orchestration imports the verifier service, not the other way around.
constraints.non_blocking_for_low_severity: Only critical/high findings go through the verifier (VERIFIABLE_SEVERITIES = {critical, high} per #335). Medium/low/info persist unchanged.
constraints.graceful_degradation: If verifier raises (network error inside the orchestration thread), log warning, persist finding with original severity + verifier_verdict=inconclusive — do NOT block finding persistence.

success_criteria: workers/orchestration/findings.py persists critical/high findings with verifier verdict already attached to the Finding row at first flush — no second-pass severity update.
assessment_loop.py post-advance hook is either removed (preferred) or kept as a defensive backstop that no-ops when the verdict is already present.
Unit test: persist a critical finding through the orchestration path → DB row immediately shows verifier_verdict in FindingAiEnrichment.metadata_json + adjusted severity if verdict=failed.
Unit test: simulate verifier exception → finding still persists, verdict=inconclusive, severity unchanged.
No regression in the 28 existing test_finding_verifier.py tests.
Live: run a real assessment loop end-to-end and confirm via DB inspection that no critical row exists without a verifier verdict for more than a single transaction.
must_not_touch: FindingAiEnrichment.metadata_json key layout (#335 contract: verdict stored under metadata_json['verifier'])

acceptance_criteria: Critical finding persistence path includes synchronous verifier call before flush.
No window exists where a critical row is visible without a verifier verdict.
Verifier exception is logged but does not block finding persistence.
